original_test_intent: Validate standard ADDDC device sparing without plus1 on the approved 64 GB x4 DIMM population by running the vendor harasser, proving its PASSED result, correctable slot attribution, no fault-light assertion and continued normal operation.
original_method: A qualified hardware operator installs the approved x4 DIMMs under ESD/power controls and an FAE configures ADDDC/EDKII and supplies a fully resolved no-plus1 harasser recipe. The operator runs the bounded harasser; the agent can validate captured topology/parameters and collect time-correlated Cscript, Windows, BMC and UEFI evidence before restoration.
manual_activity: A qualified operator must perform ESD-safe DIMM installation, BIOS/ADDDC changes, the approved harasser run, physical indicator observation and restoration. The agent can perform meaningful read-only validation and evidence collection after those gates, so the case is not wholly manual.
required_inputs: Approved 64 GB x4 DIMM PN/revision, slot/rank population and capacity map
Intel ITP/CScripts build/hash and DeviceSparingHarasser parameter contract
Explicit Standard-RAS ADDDC/adddcType and plus1-disabled value plus run time and socket/mc/ch coverage
Expected correctable slot records, PASSED signature, indicator-off and normal-operation oracle
ESD/power procedure, backup, abort, recovery and hardware/BIOS restoration plan
safety_requirements: Power-state and ESD controls for DIMM installation plus independent console and stable power
Verify DIMM PN/width/population and trained topology before enabling ADDDC
Use one fully resolved FAE-approved no-plus1 recipe; retain skipSelfCheck=False
Stop on topology mismatch, harasser self-check failure, unexpected UCE, indicator assertion, crash or health degradation
No automatic retry; restore hardware and BIOS/RAS state and verify memory health
agent_execution_scope: Validate inventory/topology and supplied parameter captures; collect read-only Cscript, Windows, BMC, UEFI and health evidence
Do not install DIMMs, alter BIOS/ADDDC, choose harasser values, inject/retry or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve DIMM recipe and no-plus1 harasser parameters/coverage
Define correctable ADDDC transition and `sparing_harasser PASSED` evidence
Specify slot attribution, indicator-off and normal-operation metrics

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The grep is only supplemental evidence; it cannot demonstrate physical x4 population, plus1 state, target mapping, full harasser success or system health and assumes Linux dmesg despite Windows.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use `ras.DeviceSparingHarasser(...)` only after every placeholder is replaced by the approved Standard-RAS/no-plus1 recipe; the title does not authorize the agent to set `plus1=False` or invent runTime/adddc/adddcType/socket/mc/ch.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: 64 GB x4-bit DIMMs, Standard RAS, without plus1, adjacent=True, debug=False, skipSelfCheck=False and 30/30-minute estimates are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Inventory and photograph the approved DIMM population, capture trained topology/capacity and ADDDC state, run one owner-resolved no-plus1 harasser with full transcript, correlate correctable slot events and indicators with a bounded health workload, then restore/diff hardware and BIOS state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Turns placeholders and `system should work normally` into explicit owner inputs and measurable evidence while retaining the Standard-RAS/no-plus1 coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A generic corrected log does not establish device sparing, no-plus1 selection, harasser PASSED, correct slot attribution or continued service.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong x4 population or ADDDC parameters can mis-train memory, create unintended UCEs, crash Windows or leave reduced/reconfigured capacity.

project_override_considerations: The physical activity does not eliminate the automatable validation/evidence portion. Per the approved classification boundary this hybrid case is REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION rather than MANUAL ONLY.
expected_evidence: Approval plus DIMM PN/revision/width/slot photos and trained topology/capacity
Package hash and complete resolved no-plus1 harasser parameters/coverage
Pre/post BIOS/ADDDC state and full Cscript transcript with `sparing_harasser PASSED`
Time-correlated Windows/EDAC, BMC correctable slot and applicable UEFI records plus front-panel/DIMM-lightpath off evidence
Bounded health/normal-operation metrics, restoration diff, memory health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: All core harasser arguments are placeholders; `without plus1` does not define the approved literal value or ADDDC type; the 64 GB x4 DIMM PN/slot population and controller coverage are absent; Windows is paired with dmesg; and optional UEFI plus `system should work normally` lack deterministic acceptance.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The Standard-RAS ADDDC/no-plus1 purpose is clear. The physical recipe, vendor parameters, oracle and recovery can be supplied, leaving execution gated but the static review complete.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 22 Wistron-System RAS-00742-V003: approve 64 GB x4 DIMM PN/revision/slot population and Standard-RAS ADDDC topology; Intel ITP/CScripts version/hash and exact DeviceSparingHarasser runTime/adddc/adddcType/plus1-disabled/socket/mc/ch values and coverage; define PASSED/correctable-slot/indicator-off/normal-operation oracle, Windows evidence, ESD/recovery and hardware/BIOS restoration.

review_improvement: This review preserves the physical ADDDC test while recognizing its automatable evidence portion and refuses to turn an unresolved parameter list into a runnable recipe.
independent_technical_reasoning: ADDDC device sparing depends on x4 DIMM organization, trained topology and a package-specific harasser configuration. The source names the no-plus1 variant but leaves every operational parameter unresolved, so choosing False and target values would be an unauthorized assumption. Physical installation and indicator observation require a person, yet topology validation, transcript analysis and OS/BMC/UEFI evidence correlation are reasonable agent work. Therefore the approved boundary makes this hybrid REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION, while the missing recipe is recorded as a source conflict rather than a DUT failure.
